sentences.text: Plotting problems constantly convert between true, magnetic and compass.
Remember the chain: true, variation, magnetic, deviation, compass, or True Virgins Make Dull Companions.
Going down the chain, from true toward compass, add west and subtract east.
Going up the chain, from compass toward true, add east and subtract west.
Write each step on paper with its sign, because a single sign error is the most common wrong answer on the plotting exam.
